sentences.text: Cassissuchus was a reptile that lived long ago.
Scientists place this animal in the family Gobiosuchidae, a specific group of extinct relatives.
The genus includes only one known species, named Cassissuchus sanziuami.
Fossils of this creature were discovered in the Calizas de La Huérgina Formation in Spain.
The genus was formally described by the researcher Buscalioni in 2017.
Currently, the Paleobiology Database records only a single fossil occurrence of this animal.
Cassissuchus lived during the Barremian stage of the Early Cretaceous, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
